title: Before and after comparison

intent.message: A restored condition is compared against the original condition in two matched panels.

claims.statement: The after panel shows the restored state of the same field as the before panel.

expected_design_characteristics: Matched field-of-view framing, scale, and brightness across the two panels
A shared scale reference instead of duplicated redundant annotations
Panel labels a and b at a consistent corner with one typography style
Equal panel sizes and gutters so the comparison is read as one unit
known_failure_modes: Panels rendered at different zoom or scale, invalidating the comparison
Inconsistent color mapping between the before and after images
Missing or inconsistently placed panel labels
